[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended classic Italian dishes for a beginner, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Appetizers (Antipasti)**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Bruschetta: Grilled bread with fresh tomatoes, basil, garlic, and mozzarella cheese.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Caprese Skewers: Fresh mozzarella, cherry tomatoes, and basil on toothpicks, drizzled with olive oil and balsamic glaze.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Primo (First Course)**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Spaghetti Aglio e Olio: Spaghetti with garlic, olive oil, and red pepper flakes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Creamy Tomato Pasta Bake: A pasta dish with ground beef, tomato sauce, and mozzarella cheese.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Secondo (Main Course)**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Chicken Parmesan: Breaded and fried chicken breasts topped with marinara sauce and melted mozzarella cheese.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Bistecca alla Fiorentina: Grilled steak served with roasted vegetables and garlic mashed potatoes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Contorno (Side Dish)**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Roasted Vegetables: Seasonal vegetables tossed with olive oil, salt, and pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Garlic and Herb Roasted Potatoes: Thinly sliced potatoes tossed with olive oil, minced garlic, and chopped fresh herbs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] **Dolce (Dessert)**:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Tiramisù: Ladyfingers soaked in coffee and liqueur, layered with mascarpone cheese and cocoa powder.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Panna Cotta: Creamy vanilla pudding topped with mixed berries and a drizzle of honey.
